caption: Did a healed man’s testimony lead priests to Jesus? Luke sends him to a priest, but Acts never links that event with its later priestly converts.

slides.alt_text: Editorial slide: A sign that converted priests? Jesus heals a man and sends him to a priest for the cleansing rite in Leviticus. Acts later says many priests became Christians.
slides.body: Jesus heals a man and sends him to a priest for the cleansing rite in Leviticus. Acts later says many priests became Christians.
slides.heading: A sign that converted priests?

slides.alt_text: The BSB text of Lev 14:11: The priest who performs the cleansing shall present the one to be cleansed, together with these offerings, before the LORD.
slides.body: The priest who performs the cleansing shall present the one to be cleansed, together with these offerings, before the LORD.
slides.heading: Lev 14:11

slides.alt_text: The claimed New Testament fulfilment in Lk 5:14, BSB: “ Do not tell anyone,” Jesus instructed him. “But go, show yourself to the priest and present the offering Moses prescribed for your cleansing, as a testimony to them.”
slides.body: “ Do not tell anyone,” Jesus instructed him. “But go, show yourself to the priest and present the offering Moses prescribed for your cleansing, as a testimony to them.”
slides.heading: Claimed fulfilment · Lk 5:14

slides.alt_text: Editorial slide: Why Christians connect them Jesus calls the offering a testimony. The healed man would bring striking evidence of Jesus’s power directly to a priest.
slides.body: Jesus calls the offering a testimony. The healed man would bring striking evidence of Jesus’s power directly to a priest.
slides.heading: Why Christians connect them

slides.alt_text: Editorial slide: But Acts never makes the link Leviticus gives a procedure after healing. Acts never says this man’s testimony converted its priests. That final step is added to the story.
slides.body: Leviticus gives a procedure after healing. Acts never says this man’s testimony converted its priests. That final step is added to the story.
slides.heading: But Acts never makes the link

title: A sign to the priests?
